title: Sweet Filipino-Style Rice Wraps
description: A twist on traditional Filipino dishes, these sweet rice wraps are perfect for a sweet snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: glazed egg
ingredients.notes: cook eggs in a glaze of 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp water

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Dust the wraps with a pinch of flour to prevent sticking.
Place a wrap in the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Flip the wrap and cook for another minute.
In a separate pan, cook the glazed eggs until heated through.
To assemble the wraps, place a cooked wrap on a flat surface.
Add a scoop of sweet rice, followed by a glazed egg.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
